skills.title: Extract a source-grounded legal term sheet
skills.summary: Build a term sheet from the agreement and supporting matter documents, with section references and issue flags.
instructions: Read the primary agreement and relevant supporting documents before drafting.
Organize the terms by topic and cite the source section for each material point.
Flag contradictions or missing provisions; do not fill gaps with invented facts.

skills.title: Verify the requested legal deliverable
skills.summary: Before finishing, check the output file, format, and requested coverage.
instructions: Write the deliverable to the designated output directory using the requested filename and format.
Reopen or inspect the produced file and check that it is nonempty and readable.
Confirm requested topics are covered using the task instructions, without accessing evaluation rubrics.

skills.title: Reconcile agreement and supporting documents
skills.summary: Use supporting evidence to distinguish agreement terms from contextual facts and open issues.
instructions: Separate controlling agreement terms from facts appearing only in supporting documents.
Check names, dates, amounts, and cross-references for conflicts before presenting conclusions.
When a source is ambiguous, describe the uncertainty and identify the document to verify.
